text:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync — goal: finalize partner listing + joint announcement schedule for the new cloud & hardware marketplace bundle. I put together a short checklist, need owners and ETA. Can folks confirm by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Liam (partner-ops): Got it. I'll own tenant provisioning and partner onboarding checklist. ETA Wed EOD. Any special SKU/metadata from HW partner?

Maya (partnerships): HW partner sent SKU list yesterday — attaching the summary in the doc (see link). Also need to confirm whether partner wants a co-branded tile vs. plain listing.

Asha (legal): FYI — we need the partner PA signed and the co-marketing addendum before any joint press. I can review drafts today but we need partner signature by Tue COB ideally.

Priya (marketing): For press/blog: proposed timeline: embargo assets out Fri, blog + press release Mon morning, socials Mon 10:00 PT. We should lock the hero image and 3 localized snippets by Thu. Who's owning localization?

Noah (solutions): We can provide localized product blurbs and 2 short use-case quotes for EN/FR/DE. I'll coordinate with partner SEs. Will deliver first pass Thu AM.

Diego (eng): Eng checklist for listing: healthcheck endpoint, sample workload, and performance blurb (p95 latency) for the bundle. Can we cut the performance blurb to the compatible model variant (quantized)? We need signoff on the final numbers — target: p95 < 120ms on Dedicated config.

Maya (partnerships): Diego — confirm if the quantized variant is acceptable for the public blurb. Partner asked to avoid calling out internal infra names.

Diego (eng): Yes, quantify as "optimized runtime" instead of product names. I'll produce the numbers from staging run by Fri.

Priya (marketing): For landing page: URL stub: https://market.redwood.ai/partners/edgehw-bundle-2026 — please include final hero copy and a 1-line partner blurb. Can design have final assets by Thu EOD? @Liam please confirm tenant staging slot.

Liam (partner-ops): Staging slot reserved for Thu 09:00–12:00 PT. I'll push sample listing then. :white_check_mark:

Asha (legal): Once I get the partner signature, I'll upload the approved copy to the legal folder and stamp the doc. Expect signature by Tue if partner returns it today.

Noah (solutions): Quick note: SI integration walkthrough doc (internal) needs a version with step-by-step commands and a short troubleshooting FAQ. I'll draft and post in #devex by Thu.

Maya (partnerships): Nice — let's summarize owners & deadlines: 
- Partner onboarding (tenant + SKU): Liam — Wed EOD
- Legal/PA + CMA: Asha — Tue COB (pending partner sig)
- Localized blurb + quotes: Noah — Thu AM
- Performance blurb & numbers: Diego — Fri
- Landing hero & assets: Design/Marketing (Priya) — Thu EOD
- Staging listing push: Liam — Thu 09:00 PT
- Internal SI doc: Noah — Thu EOD

Priya (marketing): I'll queue localization with our vendor after Noah posts blurbs. Also prepping a short Q&A for press ops — will share draft in ~2 hours.

release-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-04-18 09:00 PT -> 2026-04-18 11:00 PT. Please ensure all signoffs before 2026-04-17 17:00 PT to avoid automatic hold.

Liam (partner-ops): Noted. I'll block the preflight checklist run on Fri and ping for final signoffs.

Maya (partnerships): Thanks all — can everyone react with :thumbsup: once their items are confirmed? I'll compile a final runbook and post it here.

Priya (marketing): 👍

Diego (eng): 👍

Noah (solutions): 👍

Liam (partner-ops): 👍

Asha (legal): 👍 (pending signature)

Maya (partnerships): Great — I'll publish the runbook tonight and tag the release checklist. If anything slips, call out here asap.
